name: Ink Cloud (1/Day)
description: Trigger: The creature takes damage while underwater. Response: The creature releases ink that fills a 15-foot Cube centered on itself, and the creature moves up to its Swim Speed. The Cube is Heavily Obscured for 1 minute or until a strong current or similar effect disperses the ink.
